propositions: Enforce centralized configuration ownership through a deterministic AST gate that rejects direct ambient reads, aliased environment access, backend property reloads, and configurable adapter defaults outside approved composition seams.

Create an explicit registry of approved composition roots and provider boundaries, requiring each newly declared config/credential name to have exactly one owner and rejecting entries lacking registry membership.

Generate authoritative configuration lifecycle, security, and operator documentation from the config/adapter/ownership registries and wire ownership+consumption gates into both local linting and CI workflows.

Remove all legacy ambient facades, per-job paths, migration exception entries, and backend reloads only after synthetic red-proof fixtures, real-tree held-out tests, S1-S6 behavioral suites, and bounded-live provider/AWS review-bot/reconciler canaries all pass.
